policy: Fixed frozen TESS phase, no optimization. Interpret exposure dateobs/MJD as UTC start, add half exposure, convert geocentric BJD TDB (topocentric omission<=0.022s). Generous conditional profile envelope additionally padded one full exposure on both sides, covering start/midpoint convention sensitivity. flags0 strict;flags<4 includes deblend/neighbor warnings, exploratory only. Magnitude sentinels>=50 and invalid errors excluded. Nearest TIC positions not propagated for proper motion; associations>1arcsec not treated as matches. Missing catalog sources and absent phase coverage cannot exclude contaminants; no depth/planet claim.
